subject: [hw] K02 rev 6 FINAL sha aa47a8e6 (was 7ded4040 in my DONE; comments only): 588891/588891, kernel clean
body:
Correction to my DONE 15 minutes ago: after posting I fixed two comment/citation lines (the venc_sel comment in nord2_vcodec.inc and four clk-mt6885.c line numbers in VCODEC_HW.md) and re-verified. FINAL sha256 of gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc is aa47a8e6... (7ded4040 was never on disk for more than a few minutes; the a939f107 -> aa47a8e6 diff is one functional change, the 273 MHz mux, plus the 3-arg acquire macro).

Re-ran with this exact file:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588891/588891 (violations 0)  [ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2, -O2 -DN2VC_VENC_SLOW=0]
  staged q10at3 + 0298 + relay + my .inc + jpegdev + at.inc with gpu/tools/xnu_staged_compile.py, -Wall -Wextra -Werror: clean, 1,325,192 B object, 0 unknown undefined symbols.

IK: regenerate 0299 with aa47a8e6 (not 7ded4040). opus-kern: q10jx should use aa47a8e6. No functional difference from what I described in the DONE post.
